Native identity: a giant ant with smooth glossy jet-black chitin and prominently oversized mandibles/pincers extending forward from the head, larger and sharper than an ordinary ant's, matching the native description 'huge mandibles'.

prompt_fields.subject: One giant carpenter ant seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a compact insect body with a rounded thorax and abdomen, six legs splayed for a stable stance, and a pair of prominently oversized, sharp black mandibles projecting forward from the head, clearly larger than an ordinary ant's bite. The chitin is smooth and glossy jet-black, with a strong cool rim-light along the upper-left edges of the head, thorax and mandibles so the dark body stays readable on a dark disc.
prompt_fields.contrast: This is a new six-member family (white, brown, carpenter, blue, yellow, black ant) sharing one body plan; siblings must not be told apart by hue alone, and this identity shares its native black colour with giant black ant so it needs a second, non-colour cue. Give carpenter ant the family's most distinctive silhouette feature: oversized forward-projecting mandibles clearly bigger than any other sibling's, on an otherwise smooth, glossy carapace (silhouette: big pincers, sleek smooth legs, unlike black ant's plain mandibles and bristly matte legs, and unlike brown ant's hairy fringe). Value/finish: glossy jet-black with a broad cool-white rim-light and crisp specular highlights, distinct from black ant's duller, matte charcoal finish with a smaller, warmer highlight.
prompt_fields.composition: One complete six-legged ant centred on one circular disc, steep overhead three-quarter view, body angled so the head, mandibles and two or three legs read clearly; the mandibles, every leg and antenna stay inside the disc with the outer sixth of the disc radius left as bare base plate. Keep the head and mandibles out of the upper-right rank corner and upper-left interaction corner. No second creature, no web, no burrow, no scenery.
prompt_fields.palette: Glossy jet-black chitin with a broad cool light-grey rim-light along the upper-left edges of the head, thorax and mandibles, crisp small specular highlights, deep black-brown shading in the leg joints and creases; restrained copper-grey neutral bevel and charcoal disc at the style reference lightness; no colored faction aura.
